hypatia.source: Hypatia Catalog API v2 (composition, solar normalisation Lodders et al. 2009) - https://hypatiacatalog.com/api

hypatia.licence: Free public access, no key (API v2.2). No explicit licence stated; the Hypatia team asks that Hinkel et al. (2014) be cited.
